policy.audio: This first batch includes only source files with no audio stream. Original files are not modified.
policy.influencerIdentity: Named source folders retain their known influencer identity. Mixed unnamed folders use provisional Creator labels and keep uncertain identities separate.
policy.localFiles: Source files keep their original local names. A stable catalog name is generated from influencer, reaction, and SHA-256.
policy.review: Every asset received a manual frame review. Ambiguous clips were additionally checked across beginning, middle, and end.
policy.visualGrouping: Every video has exactly one primary visual group for feed diversity.

visualGroups.bedroom_reaction: Influencer reacting in a bedroom or bed setting.
visualGroups.cafe_reaction: Influencer seated in a cafe or restaurant environment.
visualGroups.desk_laptop_reaction: Influencer reacting while a laptop or desk setup is visually prominent.
visualGroups.fitness_workspace_reaction: Fitness-styled influencer moving beside a laptop or workspace.
visualGroups.headphones_reaction: Headphones are a prominent part of the influencer reaction.
visualGroups.indoor_selfie_closeup: Indoor face-led selfie or close-up reaction without a dominant prop.
visualGroups.indoor_selfie_medium: Indoor medium-framed reaction showing more torso or surrounding room.
visualGroups.office_selfie: Influencer in a recognizable office or shared-workspace setting.
visualGroups.phone_reaction: A phone is visibly involved in the influencer reaction.
visualGroups.sofa_reaction: Influencer reacting while seated on a sofa or lounge chair.

reactionTypes.amusement_laughter: Positive amusement, laughter, or delighted surprise.
reactionTypes.concern_anxiety: Concern, worry, stress, embarrassment, or anxious realization.
reactionTypes.confidence_approval: Confident, knowing, satisfied, or approving expression.
reactionTypes.confusion_skepticism: Confusion, doubt, skepticism, or questioning disbelief.
reactionTypes.curiosity_discovery: Curiosity, discovery, attention shift, or an emerging realization.
reactionTypes.focused_attention: Neutral-to-focused action that supplies lower-intensity Hook movement.
reactionTypes.secret_reveal: Shh, secrecy, concealed information, or a reveal gesture.
reactionTypes.shock_surprise: Clear shock, surprise, disbelief, or startled realization.
